events.title: Elk Races 7PM
events.description:
Elk Races – 2nd Fridays of the Month!

For anyone who has not yet participated in Elk Racing, it’s another low-stakes gambling game.

  • Participants bet between $1-5 on one or more elks (six total)
  • Odds are calculated based on the number of bets per elk; Elk #1 might pay 2/1 ($2 for every $1 bet); Elk #4 might pay 10/1 ($10 for every $1 bet)
  • Dice are rolled to move the elks progressively along the spots on their lane
  • The First Elk to cross the finish line is the winner, and all who bet on this elk are paid out based on the odds

*On Friday nights, we need volunteers to cook, we usually do FRY-day Friday! Check Blast/Facebook for other food options when available. Members and Guests are allowed to bring food in or have it delivered if the kitchen is closed.

Lounge opens at 4PM
Queen of Hearts 6-8PM

events.description:
🤠 Denim & Diamonds 💎

Country Western Night • Membership Drive • Veterans Food Drive

Dust off your boots, grab your favorite denim, and come join us for a fun night of country music, dancing, and good ol’ country-western fun!

🎶 Music by Pure Country & Friends
📅 Saturday, October 10, 2026
⏰ 7:00–9:00 PM
📍 Vancouver Elks Lodge #823

Whether you’re already an Elk, thinking about becoming one, or simply looking for a fun night out—everyone is welcome! This is a great opportunity to meet our members, check out the Lodge, and learn more about what we do in our community.

Veterans Food Drive

We’re also collecting canned food donations for the Clark County Veterans Assistance Center (CCVAC). The Lodge works hand-in-hand with CCVAC to help provide food for their lunch kits and other food donations that support local homeless veterans.

Bring a canned food donation with you and help us give back to those who have served our country.

💎 Admission

$15 per person + a canned food donation – through the Office/Lounge/Zeffy: https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/ticketing/denim-and-diamonds-membership-drive

So grab your boots, denim, and a little sparkle and come dance the night away with us!

Open to the Public • Membership Drive • Country Western Fun • Supporting Local Veterans

events.title: Bar Card Bingo 6PM
events.description:
Bar Card Bingo every Wednesday. All are welcome!

Bar Bingo is played with playing cards. It costs $1.00 for three cards. An app randomly picks cards; if you “match,” you flip over that card. When all three cards (in one row) are flipped, you have a Bingo!
Lots of members are there to help you play! Come on down, but be careful…..you might have too much fun!

See Blast on Tuesdays or Facebook for food options.
Lounge opens at 4PM

events.title: SlimJims Band 7PM
events.description:
Every other Wednesday, Check the calendar for details. Either SlimJims or Taska is playing in the Lodge Room.
The dance is from 7 p.m. to 9 p.m. each Wednesday.
Mixing an eclectic variety of popular music with unconventional “B-side” hits. The SlimJims put their alternative upbeat twist on over five decades of quality American roots music.

Come early to get a seat, as early as 6 PM. The lounge offers Bar Bingo from 6-8 PM.

*Cover is $6 for Elk members and $10 for the general public.

See Blast on Tuesdays or Facebook for food options, 5-7PM.
Lounge opens at 4 PM

events.title: Texas Hold-Em Tournament
events.description:
♠️♥️ TEXAS HOLD-EM POKER TOURNAMENT ♦️♣️
Now at Vancouver Elks Lodge #823!

Get ready for an exciting night of cards, competition, and fun as we kick off our NEW monthly Texas Hold-Em Tournament every 4th Friday of the month!

Whether you’re a seasoned poker player or just looking for a fun night at the Lodge, come join us for an evening of friendly competition and great company.

🃏 Tournament Details:
• Open to Members and Guests (single guest per member)
• $5 Buy-In
• No Add-Ons • No Re-Buys
• 100% Pay-Out to Winner(s)
• 10,000 Starting Chips
• Max Players: 40

⏰ Schedule:
• Sign-Ups Begin: 5 PM
• Entries Close / Seating Draw: 6:45 PM
• Cards Fly Promptly at 7 PM
• Blinds Increase Every 15 Minutes
• 15 Minute Break at 8 PM

📍 Full tournament rules and details are posted in the Stag Bar.

For more information or questions, contact:
PER Jim Majorowicz
📧 jim@gothyo.com

Bring your poker face and join us for a great night at the Vancouver Elks Lodge #823! 🏆🃏

events.title: Seahawks Club
events.description:
The Seahawks Club is back!
Lounge opens 1 hour prior to kickoff time.

Hawks Club membership is $40 for Membership and can be paid in the Lounge or the Office. These funds pay for our subscription to Red Zone and other costs of running the Hawks Club.

When the Seahawks score a touchdown, members will receive a ticket for a free drink (Draft beer, box wine, or well drink only). Due to state rules, a maximum of 5 free drink tickets will be issued to each member per game. Drink tickets must be used during the game timeline: 1 hour before, during, and 1 hour after or before the kickoff of the next Hawks Club meet-up. Drink tickets have no value during regular lodge hours.
When the opposing team scores, everyone is requested to deposit .50¢ in the Hawks Club Bank.
Non-members are encouraged to participate with us.

For more details contact PER Diane Nelson.

Check out the Seahawks 2026 Schedule here:
https://www.seahawks.com/schedule/
